# Columbia University Department of Psychiatry

> > Leading academic psychiatry department at Columbia University Irving Medical Center and New York State Psychiatric Institute, advancing mental health research, clinical training, and public health initiatives.

The department offers comprehensive psychiatry residency and postdoctoral training programs while conducting cutting-edge research on suicide prevention, depression, HIV mental health, and diagnostic assessment tools including the Structured Clinical Interview for DSM (SCID). Faculty experts regularly contribute to national conversations on mental health policy, medical ethics, and public health crises.

## Key Topics

- Psychiatry Residency Training
- Suicide Prevention Research
- Depression and Anxiety Treatment
- New York State Psychiatric Institute
- NIMH-Funded Research
- Structured Clinical Interview for DSM (SCID)
- Graduate Medical Education
- HIV Mental Health
- Public Health Crisis Response
- Medical Ethics and Policy
- Clinical Assessment Tools
- Psychotropic Medication Practices
- Campus Sexual Assault Prevention
- Mailman School of Public Health Collaboration

## Education and Training Programs

- [Psychiatry Residency](https://www.columbiapsychiatry.org/education-and-training/psychiatry-residency): Columbia University psychiatry residency program for clinical training
- [HIV Postdoctoral Training Program](https://www.columbiapsychiatry.org/education-and-training/research-training/hiv-postdoctoral-training-program): THRIVE postdoctoral program for HIV prevention and mental health research
- [PGY 4 Year](https://www.columbiapsychiatry.org/education-and-training/psychiatry-residency/core-curriculum/pgy-4-year): Fourth-year psychiatry residency curriculum and training requirements

## Research Labs and Clinical Tools

- [Diagnostic and Assessment/Structured Clinical Interview for DSM Lab](https://www.columbiapsychiatry.org/research-labs/diagnostic-and-assessment-structured-clinical-interview-dsm-lab): SCID lab developing DSM diagnostic assessment tools and training materials

## News and Updates

- [News](https://www.columbiapsychiatry.org/news): Columbia Psychiatry news hub featuring research and faculty updates

## Suicide Prevention and Mental Health Crisis

- [A life cut short: Trying to understand suicide](https://www.columbiapsychiatry.org/news/life-cut-short-trying-understand-suicide): Celebrity suicides and the growing public health crisis coverage
- [123 Deaths a Day: Inside the Public Health Crisis of Rising Suicide Rates](https://www.columbiapsychiatry.org/news/123-deaths-day-inside-public-health-crisis-rising-suicide-rates-united-states): Dr. J. John Mann discusses CDC report on rising U.S. suicide rates

## Mental Health Policy and Ethics

- [The U.S. Has A Long History Of Drugging Distressed Kids In Its Custody](https://www.columbiapsychiatry.org/news/u-s-has-long-history-drugging-distressed-kids-its-custody): Analysis of psychotropic medication practices in detention facilities
- [Is There a Smarter Way to Think About Sexual Assault on Campus?](https://www.columbiapsychiatry.org/news/there-smarter-way-think-about-sexual-assault-campus): Columbia researchers' SHIFT approach to campus sexual assault prevention
- ['Goldwater Rule' Under Fire Again](https://www.columbiapsychiatry.org/news/goldwater-rule-under-fire-again): APA's Goldwater Rule on psychiatric diagnosis debated as outdated

## Treatment Approaches and Patient Care

- [Dealing with Anxiety Without Meds](https://www.columbiapsychiatry.org/news/no-med-approach-dealing-anxiety): Non-medication strategies and tools for managing anxiety naturally
